context:
Goal: cloud sessions and your Mac sessions leave each other messages in git (your item 153 pick a).
Problem (risk): claude-settings is public, so a message there is readable by anyone, for good. A cloud session cannot create a repo.
Based on (read): list_repos at 15:27 CST: claude-settings is public, and no private repo exists for this purpose.
Departs from: main, which has no mailbox store — adds one.
Meanwhile: a Plan agent designs the mailbox (format, read at turn start, cost), with the store left as a setting. The build starts once you pick.
holds: Which repo holds the session mailbox.

options.gain: Private, and nothing mixed into a code repo.
options.how: You create it once at https://github.com/new: owner shivinate7, name session-mailbox, Private, no README. Then every session reads and writes it.
options.label: New private repo session-mailbox
options.lose: One minute of your time, and one more repo to keep.

options.label: A branch in claude-settings
options.lose: Every message is public for good, so sessions must keep personal data and private repo names out of each one.

options.how: A mailbox branch in an existing private repo, such as shivinate7/home.
options.label: A branch in a private repo you have
options.lose: Mixes session mail into a repo with its own CI and purpose.

title: Where should the git mailbox for cloud and Mac sessions live?
why: Messages can hold repo names, file paths and your words, and claude-settings is public.
